integrity: Mathematical proof reconstructed; executable exact finite-field cross-check included; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification counts ordered nonzero coefficient pairs, not isomorphism classes; it classifies the union of maximal and minimal cases, not their separate counts; p odd, h=1 and base field F_{p^4} only. Finite checks for p=3,5 supplement a proof for all odd p. Literature novelty carries a residual risk of unindexed equivalent coefficient classifications.
title: A complete extremality criterion for two-term Artin–Schreier curves over \(\mathbb F_{p^4}\)
